internal_fipa_broker.description: In-process strongly-typed FIPA-ACL broker for low-latency agent handoffs.

official_a2a_sdk.description: Official Google A2A Protocol v0.3.0 implementation using `a2a-sdk`.

provenance_clarification: Dual-tier architecture: `testforge/a2a.py` provides the internal in-process typed FIPA-ACL broker, while `testforge/a2a_protocol.py` implements the official Google A2A Protocol v0.3.0 specification via `a2a-sdk`.
